decision_conditions: The Local Planning Authority is not satisfied, on the basis of the evidence submitted, that it has been adequately established through this application that the premises at Tile Kiln Farm, EN2 has been used as a store and/or distribution (B8 use) for a continuous period of 10 years prior to the date of this application and so cannot be established under the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended in section 171(b) (3).
